dedupe_keys.name: georeferenced industrial sites with fuel demand and excess heat potential hotmaps industrial database

description: This database lists over 5,000 georeferenced industrial sites of energy-intensive sectors with GHG emissions, production capacity, fuel demand and excess heat potentials calculated from emission and production data. The Zenodo record says it is a re-upload of the file in the Hotmaps GitLab repository. It was published by Pia Manz and Tobias Fleiter of the Fraunhofer Institute for Systems and Innovation Research (version 1.1, 2021) under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as one CSV of about 1 MB. Coverage follows the Hotmaps project, which is European; the exact country list is not stated on the page read. Caveats: fuel demand and excess heat are modelled estimates, not metered values, and the reference year is not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives site-level industrial energy demand and recoverable heat to plan district heating, industrial energy transition and energy supply disruption impacts. Related catalogue records include the Hotmaps electricity and district heating scenarios and the U.S. industrial facilities technology performance data.
